specifications.role: diagnostic sensitivity; ANC_18 retained in linking
diagnostic sensitivity; signed ANC_14 and ANC_18 retained in linking

observed_score.convention: R(s)=P(S<s)+0.5*P(S=s); linear interpolation between integer mid-CDF knots; B-to-A is inverse_R_A(R_B(s))
observed_score.endpoints: integer support 0..60 only; no extrapolation outside reference mid-CDF range; return unavailable rather than clip
observed_score.zero_mass_or_flat_percentile_intervals: generalized inverse interval; nonunique mapping withheld
observed_score.support_rule: central requires source percentile in [0.025,0.975] and both corresponding mid-CDF roots within fixed Stage 7 central theta overlap; otherwise weak tail; unavailable mappings remain unavailable

counterfactual_tail_rule: compare source mid-percentile to interpolated reference boundary percentile; this orders the threshold without fabricating unavailable tail scores
sensitivity_summaries: maximum absolute continuous-mapping difference on common central B scores
substantive_sensitivity_threshold: none; numerical summaries are descriptive, not universal acceptability cutoffs

uncertainty.primary: reuse all 200 Stage 7 paired candidate bootstraps
uncertainty.secondary: reuse all 1000 Stage 7 paired joint-covariance draws
uncertainty.interval: linear empirical 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles; pointwise, not simultaneous

scope: Stage 8 research only; no operational scoring application, decision replacement, classification consistency, standard setting, final PDF or certification recommendation
